summary: The root وزع (wazʿa) refers to a group of people, like assistants or followers. It can also describe someone who restrains or prevents.
lane: الوَزَعَةُ ذ i. q. أَعْوَانُ الرَّجُلِ . (TA in art. امل .) وازِعٌ : see فَارِعٌ .
